== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 21: the slip of [[At Peace (V) (Virtual Block 6)#Source formats|At Peace (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on Dagobah: Yoda's Hut{{!}}Yoda's Hut. May use 1 Force to prevent Broken Concentration from modifying your training destiny (and Strong Is Vader from retrieving Force) this turn. If Luke (V){{!}}Luke has completed Jedi Test #5 and is about to be hit, may place this Effect out of play to prevent it.”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
